title: Nurse Manager IPC contract, version 1
description: Every message the manager core sends to the desktop host. Each CLI command prints one Envelope; commands.json names the data type for each command. TypeScript types in nurse-manager-ipc.d.ts are generated from this file.

IpcError.description: A truthful failure. The message is written for the manager; type names the error class.

sample.description: True for the synthetic sample workspace; every view must say so.

AssistantsSection.description: Every assistant working or waiting to work, and the one switch that stops them all (step 5.3). Also the answer to assistants-stop and assistants-resume.

stopped.description: While true, nothing is sent to a model, running requests are abandoned and their replies discarded, and the recurring brief waits.

changed_by.description: Who last stopped or restarted assistants; empty if nobody has.

AssistantAtWork.description: A request waiting for a model right now, or the recurring brief waiting for its time.

since.description: When a request began; null for the schedule.

MissionControl.description: What needs my attention? Every section reads the same records as the board and table.

Readiness.description: Stated facts about readiness. Deliberately not a score or a percentage.

tasks_without_next_action.description: Ready or in-progress tasks with no next action written down.

Feedback.description: Feedback about a project's work, from a group or role. Never about a named person or anyone's performance. Addressed means a response was written.

MemoryItem.description: One thing the manager asked the assistant to remember, in their own words. Excluded or expired memories are kept but never sent.

provenance.description: Who wrote or last corrected it, and when.

PackTemplate.description: One template a pack uses, from the shared deliverable catalog.

Pack.description: A reviewed, versioned set of templates with its maintainer and review dates. Only a current pack can start a document; one past its review date, or failing its checks, says why.

reason.description: Why it cannot start a document; empty when current.

PackDocument.description: A document started from a pack: which pack version and template, and where its latest revision stands.

has_accepted.description: Some revision is accepted, even if a newer draft exists.

Packs.description: Education, committee, and communication packs, and the documents started from them.

projects.description: Projects a new document can be for.

PackDocumentView.description: One pack document: the latest revision (rendered with its banner, and its raw text to edit) and the accepted one. Accept it with the accept command.

markdown.description: The only rendering; it always carries its status banner.

body_markdown.description: The text to edit; send its revision sha256 back as the base.

Memory.description: Scoped memory: in use first, then expired, then excluded. Only memories in use are ever sent, and only to Think with this project.

projects.description: Projects a new memory can be scoped to.

MemoryDeleted.description: The memory is gone; only its id remains, in the audit log.

ContributionItem.description: One of the manager's contributions and who shares the credit. Verified means the manager wrote the evidence that shows it happened.

shared_credit.description: Teams, groups or roles; never a ranking of named colleagues.

Contributions.description: Contributions: drafts awaiting evidence, then verified, newest first. Stated facts, never a score or a ranking.

this_year_verified.description: Verified contributions that happened in the calendar year of today, whenever they were verified.

projects.description: Projects a new contribution can be linked to.

LearningItem.description: One piece of the manager's own professional learning. Completed means a takeaway and a date were written.

Learning.description: Learning and Growth: in progress, planned, then completed. Stated facts, never a score.

past_target.description: Not completed and past its target date.

LibraryItem.description: One source in the workspace. The reference is shown as text, never opened by the app.

Library.description: Every source in the workspace, overdue reviews first.

projects.description: Projects a new source can belong to.

ProjectDashboard.description: What will move this initiative forward? Tasks use the same rows and ids as the table.

feedback.description: Open feedback first, then addressed; newest first within each.

notes.description: AI answers the manager chose to keep, newest first.

Revision.description: One revision of a brief. Accepted means a human accepted exactly this text (sha256).

created_by.description: Who wrote this text: the manager, or assistant:<provider> for a model's draft.

WeeklyBrief.description: One week's brief: the newest revision, rendered with its status banner, and the accepted revision if there is one.

BriefSchedule.description: The recurring weekly brief: a records-only draft prepared at the chosen local weekday and hour while the app runs on this computer. Off by default.

next_at.description: When the next draft is due, in local time; null when off. A past time means it runs within a minute.

stopped.description: The manager has stopped assistants: nothing is prepared until they let them work again.

BriefRun.description: The one scheduled run for a week. Drafted: a draft is waiting for review. Skipped: the week already had a brief. Failed: retried up to three attempts in all.

BriefRunResult.description: What one check of the recurring brief did.

markdown.description: The only rendering; it always carries its status banner.

Action.description: A governed action. Draft ready, accepted, exported, and sent are distinct states.

ReconcileResult.description: After a crash: every export that was interrupted, settled by checking the file on disk. Nothing is run again; an empty list means nothing was interrupted.

PilotFeedbackItem.description: One piece of pilot feedback about the app itself, kept on this computer.

exported_at.description: When it was last in an export the manager made; null if never.

PilotFeedback.description: The manager's pilot feedback, newest first. Nothing here is sent anywhere; an export is text the manager saves and shares themselves.

PilotFeedbackDeleted.description: The feedback is gone; only its id remains, in the audit log.

PilotFeedbackPreview.description: Exactly the text an export would hold, and whether the privacy screen lets it be made. Nothing is exported or sent. Findings are entity types only, never the matched text.

reason.description: Why it cannot be exported; empty when it can.

PilotFeedbackExport.description: The export the manager reviewed: the same text and hash as the preview. The manager saves it and decides who receives it.

pre_restore_backup.description: Always taken, so even an accepted discard is recoverable.

UpdateArtifact.description: One download a signed feed names. Check the file against its sha256 before installing.

UpdateRelease.description: A release newer than this one, from a feed whose signature verified.

schema.description: The workspace schema it upgrades to; empty if the feed does not say.

UpdateCheck.description: The answer to checking for updates. Advisory only: nothing is downloaded or installed. not_configured means no update key is pinned, so no feed is trusted.

AssistantProvider.description: The connected AI provider. 'none' is the default (ADR 0004). There is no cloud value until a cloud service is chosen.

AssistantStatus.description: AI settings, usage so far, and the gates every provider passes.

runs_on.description: Where the text goes, said plainly.

AssistantCheck.description: One gate that runs before anything is sent.

AssistantPreview.description: Exactly what asking the model would send, and the gates' verdicts. Nothing is sent to produce it. With no model connected, system and prompt are empty and will_send is false.

system.description: The instructions sent to the model.

prompt.description: The record text sent to the model.

prompt_sha256.description: Send it back with assistant-brief; a change since the preview refuses the request.

reason.description: Why nothing would be sent. Empty when will_send is true.

ProjectQuestionPreview.description: Exactly what asking the model about one project would send, and the gates' verdicts. Nothing is sent to produce it. With no model connected, system and prompt are empty and will_send is false.

system.description: The instructions sent to the model.

prompt.description: The question and the project's record text sent to the model.

prompt_sha256.description: Send it back with assistant-project; a change since the preview refuses the request.

reason.description: Why nothing would be sent. Empty when will_send is true.

classifier.description: JEV's refusal check on the question (ADR 0006): what it would be sent before the model sees the question. Send its request_sha256 back with assistant-project when will_send is true.

ProjectAnswer.description: The answer to a question about one project. It is a suggestion shown to the manager and is never saved; the ledger keeps only metadata.

outcome.description: refused_intake: JEV's refusal check stopped the question before the model saw it; request_id is then JEV's request.

reason.description: Written for the manager. Empty only when the model answered.

question.description: The question as asked, whitespace normalized. Send it back with note-keep.

answer.description: Markdown with record citations; empty unless the model answered.

refusal.description: Why JEV refused the question, and the nearest permitted path; null unless outcome is refused_intake.

classifier_note.description: What JEV's refusal check did when it ran and did not refuse: found nothing, was not sure, or was unavailable and the question went on without it. Empty when the check is off, or when it refused (see refusal).

ProjectNote.description: An AI answer the manager kept. Its text is exactly what the model answered (proven by the hash the request ledger recorded), and keeping it was the manager's acceptance.

AssistantOutcome.description: What happened to one request. Every outcome except 'drafted' returns the draft composed from records.

AssistantDraft.description: The answer to asking for an AI draft of the weekly brief. The revision is always a draft; drafted_by_model says whether a model wrote it.

reason.description: Written for the manager. Empty only when a model drafted it.

ClassifierProvider.description: JEV, or nothing. 'none' is the default (ADR 0006).

ClassifierJobs.description: Which of JEV's jobs are on. All are off by default, and none can be on while JEV is not connected.

ClassifierStatus.description: JEV settings, usage, what it does and never does, the gates every request passes, and TypeSafe's terms as read. Never the key.

model.description: The pinned model, e.g. jev-1.13.0; empty when not connected.

runs_on.description: Where the text goes, said plainly.

keystore.description: Where the key is kept: the operating system's credential store.

ClassifierPreview.description: Exactly what asking JEV would send, and the gates' verdicts. Nothing is sent to produce it. When JEV is off or the job is off, request is empty and will_send is false.

request.description: The exact JSON body JEV would receive.

request_sha256.description: Send it back with the request; a change since the preview refuses it.

reason.description: Why nothing would be sent. Empty when will_send is true.

ClassifierActionPreview.description: Exactly what asking JEV about one proposed action would send. Nothing is sent to produce it.

ClassifierOutcome.description: What happened to one JEV request. Only 'answered' carries JEV's answer; every other outcome leaves things as they are without JEV.

ClassifierActionResult.description: JEV's suggestion beside the policy's decision on one action. A hold must be acknowledged before approval; the policy's decision never changes.

core_decision.description: The policy's decision, as the option it corresponds to.

ClassifierRefusal.description: A refusal category JEV found in a question, and the nearest permitted path.

ClassifierRoute.description: Where JEV suggests a request belongs. A suggestion only: the manager chooses, and nothing starts.

request.description: The request as asked, whitespace normalized. Never stored.

suggested.description: Empty when JEV was not sure or did not answer.

ClassifierOrder.description: A suggested order for Needs my judgment. Every item is kept; no score is given. When JEV is unsure or unavailable, the usual order is returned.
